retraction.reason: Retracted in M42 batch 16 under brief §1: the record earns no honest edge. The English article, at revision 1308579780, traces the charter to a 1979 Organisation of African Unity assembly decision and to the drafting committee that followed, and describes what it obliges; the OAU is not a record here and no event this atlas holds is named. It waits on a record of African decolonisation or of the OAU itself, and it is the seventh instrument this milestone has retracted on arrival.
